attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No Yang-Mills estimate currently computes or bounds the finite-block Wilson boundary OPE coefficients H and K for reflected hairpins with coincident boundary footprint.
steps: Start with regulated reflection positivity: every cutoff collar block N_{a,L,eta} is PSD for gauge-invariant Wilson observables supported in t>eta.
Use the cutoff-removal topology only on fixed collars to pass to N_eta>=0. This part is a valid closed-cone argument.
Model the eta->0 collapse by a multiplicative boundary matrix B_eta. The target same-theory matrix is M_eta=B_eta^{[-1]} circ N_eta, not N_eta itself.
Normalize by positive diagonals. OS positivity of M_eta is equivalent to PSD of q_eta=widehat N_eta oslash widehat B_eta.
Assume a finite-block boundary OPE q_eta=J+eta H+eta^2K+o(eta^2). Decompose C^n=span{u} plus u^perp.
The u-block equals n+O(eta), so it is invertible. Its Schur complement on u^perp is eta PHP+eta^2 P(K-n^{-1}Huu^*H)P+o(eta^2).
Therefore q_eta>=0 forces PHP>=0. If x lies in ker(PHP), the eta^2 coefficient gives the corrected second-order test.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The derivation is valid finite-dimensional linear algebra conditional on the OPE expansion and same-theory multiplicative separation. Those are precisely the missing analytic Wilson-loop inputs.

branch_outputs.branch_title: Reflection-Positivity Closed-Cone Topology: Wilson quotient tangent cone

assumptions: The fixed-collar closed-cone passage is valid: N_eta>=0 for each eta>0 after cutoff removal.
B_eta is Hermitian with positive diagonal and no zero entries on the finite block.
The quotient has a uniform boundary OPE expansion q_eta=J+eta H+eta^2 K+o(eta^2) with H,K Hermitian and q_eta,ii=1.
The finite Wilson block is locked before taking eta->0, so the quotient tests the same theory rather than an enlarged boundary algebra.
definitions: source object: finite collar Wilson OS blocks N_eta obtained as RG limits of regulated reflection-positive gauge-invariant Schwinger forms
target object: continuum OS matrix for the same locked Wilson observables after the collar is collapsed to the reflection plane
controlled interface: regulated reflection-positive Schwinger forms -> OS-positive continuum Schwinger functions, reduced to finite Schur-preimage positivity q_eta>=0

same-theory condition: the boundary collapse may use only the prescribed Wilson renormalization; any extra multiplicative factor B_eta must be divided out without adding boundary degrees of freedom or changing the test algebra
u=n^{-1/2}(1,...,1) and P=I-uu^* project off the rank-one OS vacuum direction.
J is the all-one matrix, J=n uu^*. q_eta is the normalized Schur quotient q_eta=widehat N_eta oslash widehat B_eta.

equations.label: normalized quotient expansion
equations.valid_when: Valid when the reflected Wilson boundary OPE is uniform on the chosen finite block and diagonal renormalizations have been removed by congruence.

equations.label: Schur complement after removing J direction
equations.valid_when: Valid for u=n^{-1/2}(1,...,1), P=I-uu^*, and eta small enough that the rank-one block n+O(eta) is invertible.

equations.label: first and second tangent gates
equations.valid_when: Necessary for q_eta>=0 as eta downarrow 0; sufficient to second order if the displayed forms have a positive gap on their active subspaces.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Find reflected Wilson hairpins and a zero-sum vector x with x^*PHPx<0, or with PHPx=0 and x^*P(K-n^{-1}Huu^*H)Px<0.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Turns the unresolved Wilson boundary step into computable OPE coefficients H and K, while leaving the closed-cone RG-to-OS passage as a formal valid input.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Second-order tangent-cone bridge for Wilson collar collapse. For a locked finite Wilson block with normalized same-theory quotient q_eta tending to the all-one matrix J, target OS positivity forces PHP>=0 on 1^perp and, on ker(PHP), the corrected second-order form P(K-n^{-1}Huu^*H)P to be nonnegative. A negative value is a finite Wilson falsifier.

assumptions: N_ii>0 and B_ii>0 for all chosen observables.
B_ij is nonzero on the tested block; otherwise the quotient is not a valid same-theory object.
All single-observable boundary renormalizations are already part of the locked Wilson definition.
definitions: N is the collar-limit OS matrix supplied by reflection positivity and RG convergence.
B is the multiplicative boundary anomaly matrix for reflected Wilson products.
M=B^{[-1]} circ N is the intended no-boundary-state target matrix.
widehat A denotes correlation normalization A_ij/(A_ii A_jj)^{1/2}.

equations.label: normalized preimage criterion
equations.valid_when: Valid when B has positive diagonal and no zero entries, so Hadamard division is defined.

equations.label: finite OS test
equations.valid_when: Valid up to positive diagonal congruence, which preserves OS positivity.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Compute a principal minor of q that is negative even though N>=0; this is a same-theory falsifier.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Supplies the exact finite matrix bridge behind the tangent-cone test.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Finite Schur-preimage exactness. After additive contacts are ruled out and diagonal factors are absorbed by same-theory congruences, the intended target Wilson OS block is positive iff the normalized quotient q=widehat N oslash widehat B is positive semidefinite.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot if a perturbative or rigorous hairpin calculation yields a negative first- or second-order tangent gate, because then the same-theory OS bridge fails.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote if one proves uniform Wilson boundary OPE with PHP>=0 and positive Schur-corrected second-order form on a dense locked Wilson core, plus fixed-collar RG convergence.
control_decision.reason: The branch is still learning: the obstruction is now a concrete finite-dimensional OPE test rather than a topology slogan.

dependency_updates.description: The fixed-collar part is formally valid by closed-cone transfer; the boundary step is now the Schur-preimage quotient q_eta>=0 and its tangent-cone gates.
dependency_updates.status: partially resolved; blocked at Wilson boundary OPE

dependency_updates.description: The Wilson block must be locked before collar collapse; boundary states or new counterterms would prove positivity for a different algebra.
It must dominate fixed-collar reflected quadratic forms and support uniform eta->0 OPE extraction for q_eta.
Compute H and K for finite reflected hairpin blocks and test PHP plus the corrected second-order Schur form.

falsifiers: falsifier: a locked Wilson block with a zero-sum vector x and x^*PHPx<0 gives an immediate negative OS determinant for small collar width.
falsifier: PHP>=0 but a null vector x has x^*P(K-n^{-1}Huu^*H)Px<0, showing a second-order boundary obstruction.
falsifier: the collar collapse produces B_ij=0 or a nonmultiplicative/additive boundary contact not killed by diagonal trace continuity, so q is not a valid same-theory quotient.
falsifier: RG convergence controls fixed collars but not the reflected Wilson OPE uniformly as eta->0, leaving the closed-cone topology too weak for the target OS matrix.
branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 220 converts the previous warning about second order into a precise valid tangent-cone lemma. The rank-one OS direction contributes the correction -n^{-1}Huu^*H, so the next falsifier is not just a negative K term but a negative Schur-corrected boundary OPE form on ker(PHP). The branch has reduced the nonformal Yang-Mills task to computing H and K for locked reflected Wilson blocks.
